_note: campaign P4a (PLAN G5, G6): the data the graph-structure check (graph-structure-check.js) reads. instanceOwnerEdgeTypeByLabelSuffix: the ONE edge that names an instance's group, by the suffix of the instance's own label (a DmeInstance whose label matches no suffix is refused by name, never guessed). codeListSourceCensusRuleByStandardFamily: where a forge keeps a FROZEN SOURCE census of its code lists (counted from the release files by a separate tool, not by the walk), and which of its fields count option sets and option values; a standard whose family has no rule is reported by name as not compared to a source census.
